description: This PHP class represents a data transfer object (DTO) for employee licenses within the OrangeHRM HR management system. It provides methods to serialize license data to an array, referencing employee license entities and including mapping for license-related fields.

classes.name: License
classes.description: A data transfer object for employee license information, capable of normalizing license data related to an employee for reporting purposes within the HRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the License DTO with an employee number.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts license information to an array based on specified fields.

methods.name: getFieldGetterMap
methods.description: Provides a mapping of field names to getter methods for license data extraction.
